description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'SystemTargetShared', which manages references and utilities for system targets within the Orleans runtime, including logging, configuration options, and activation handling.

classes.name: SystemTargetShared
classes.description: Internal sealed class that encapsulates references to runtime components, logging, and configuration for system targets.

methods.name: CreateWorkItemGroup
